name: HCA Gut Cell Atlas v1 Lymphoid Lineage
description: Healthy and adjacent-to-disease control data from 27 gut single-cell RNAseq datasets were collected and integrated to form v1 of the Human Gut Cell Atlas lymphoid lineage

labelsets.name: Prelim annotation
labelsets.description: Cell annotations (Prelim annotation) are based on the finest possible label that could be used to describe each of the ~500 clusters found during integration and subclustering

labels.name: CD4 Th17
labels.rationale: Since both ILC3s and Th17 express RORC and IL7R, these can be difficult to separate. Th17 were annotated when larger clusters of naive T cells showed a clear IL7R and RORC expressing subcluster

labels.name: CD8 Effector/Memory
labels.fullName: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
labels.ontologyTerm: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
labels.rationale: No CX3CR1 but IL2, granzymes, and CD8 signatures are found abundantly in single cell data of the gut

labels.name: T NKT
labels.rationale: ZBTB16 expressing, CD7, JUND, NKG7, these could be NK T cells - but not sure of TCR expression
labels.ontologyAssessment: unconventional T cell category would be useful to encapsulate non-CD8/CD4 t cell subclasses. https://doi.org/10.1038/ni.3298

labels.name: CD8 Circulating Effector/Memory
labels.fullName: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: KLRG1, FGFBP2, CX3CR1, GZMH expressing set of clusters found across tissue sections

labels.name: CD8 TRM
labels.rationale: ITGAE and RORA point to granzyme positive t resident memory populations, and clusters of these tend to be more unique to certain sections of the gut, driving down the number of datasets they are found in (dataset diversity metric)
synonyms: tissue resident memory CD8 T cell

labels.name: CD4 Naive
labels.rationale: CD4 Naive T cells are defined as CCR7, IL7R, LEF1 and SELL expressing signatures

labels.name: CD8 IEL
labels.rationale: A large cluster of ITGAE high, CD160 exists in the atlas, pointing to resident status. contextualization with radial tissue terms could increase evidence

labels.name: T Cycling
labels.rationale: Cycling T cells were annotated based on STMN1, MKI67 and other cell cycle genes alongside a T lineage background, including TRAC

labels.name: B Atypical
labels.rationale: FCRL4 and FCRL5 point to atypical B cells, but ITGAX was not found here
labels.ontologyAssessment: atypical/unconventional B and T cell groups could be useful for hierarchical consistency?

labels.name: CD4 Memory
labels.rationale: When CD4 celltypes show no clear evidence of Treg, Naive, or Th states, but contain a clear interleukin, MAF, and differentiated signal, we annotate them as CD4 Memory

labels.name: B Marginal zone (MZB)
labels.fullName: marginal B cell of lymph node
labels.ontologyTerm: marginal B cell of lymph node
labels.rationale: FCRL1, CD1C with HLA, CD79 signatures point to potential MZB cells

labels.name: doublets
labels.rationale: A Cell Annotation Platform (CAP) term used to identify a row in a “cell by gene” table that appears to contain combined data from a pair of cells rather than data from one cell and should therefore be discarded.

labels.name: ILC NK Cells
labels.rationale: Marker lists with high NKG7 and GNLY point to NK subsets

labels.name: Plasma IGA
labels.rationale: These are easily distinguished from other plasma subsets via IGHA variants

labels.name: CD4 Treg
labels.rationale: Coexpress FOXP3 and IL2RA (CD25), FOXP3 expression quickly identifies clusters of T-regs

labels.name: CD4 Th1
labels.rationale: Th1 are annotated when CD4 cells show IFNG or TNF program signatures and especially IL7R. Thelper cytotoxic dual signatures point then to Th1

labels.name: ILC NKs
labels.rationale: This was a misspelling, should be ILC NK Cells

labels.name: CD4 Tfh
labels.rationale: CD40LG and ICOS are used to annotate Tfh in this data. These are also found in larger clusters of CD4 naive cells

labels.name: GC B Light Zone
labels.rationale: BANK1 is found in all subsets annotated as LZ, TNFRSF13C supports in some

labels.name: ILC3
labels.rationale: KRT86, RORC, IL7R and IL23R point to strong ILC3 signature, while some nearby subclusters show a more ILC or ILC2 tilt

labels.name: B Memory
labels.rationale: CD27, HLA-DRA, SELL, and CD69 separated memory B cells from other B subsets

labels.name: GC B Germinal Center
labels.rationale: CXCR4 high b cells with no other evidence of light or dark zone markers. These had high mitochondrial content so may just be of too low quality to define

labels.name: ILC2
labels.rationale: ST2 is found in one subcluster of ~1000 cells among other ILC clusters, pointing to ILC2. 16_0 could also be ILC2 due to ST2 expression

labels.name: CD8 T
labels.rationale: broadly annotated when CD8 T cells didn't show sufficient markers to resolve finer states

labels.name: GC B Dark Zone
labels.rationale: CXCR4 high with CD83 point to Dark zone

labels.name: B Naive
labels.rationale: MARCKSL1 and IGHD were found in some subclusters found near other follicular B cells. These have high HLA genes, CD79A and B

labels.name: CD8 Memory/Exhausted
labels.rationale: TOX, CD27, GZM pointed to CD8 memory here, and HAVCR2 pointed to an exhausted signature

labels.name: CD8 Naive
labels.fullName: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: Proximity to other CD8 clusters and LEF1 expression allowed me to annotate this ~7k cell sub-cluster found amongst other CD4 clusters as CD8 naive.

labels.name: T GammaDelta
labels.rationale: TRDC, TRGC2 and SOX4 point to gamma delta T cells, but these do not show the canonical TRGC9, TRDC2 variants.
labels.ontologyAssessment: unconventional T cell category would be useful to encapsulate non-CD8/CD4 t cell subclasses. https://doi.org/10.1038/ni.3298

labels.name: B Cycling
labels.rationale: B cells (HLA, CD79) with clear STMN1 and other cell cycle signal

labels.name: Plasma Cells
labels.rationale: JCHAIN, MZB1, SSR4, and IG*

labels.name: Plasma IGG
labels.rationale: IGHG

labels.name: ILC1
labels.rationale: General ILC signature with IFNG expression

labels.name: junk
labels.rationale: A Cell Annotation Platform (CAP) term used to identify a row in a “cell by gene” table that appears to contain non-cellular data rather than data from one cell and should therefore be discarded.

labels.name: T MAIT
labels.rationale: This small subcluster uniquely clearly expressed the TRAV1-2 MAIT TCR marker

labels.name: Plasma IGM
labels.rationale: Same with IGHM
